value.rationale: The fixed Ω/ω exponent-signature layer is a natural arithmetic stratum; for every layer the theorem supplies both exact extrema and unique shape equality conditions, and its strict transfer rule compares infinitely many interior pairs. It resolves a qualitative structural gap not captured by enumerating known Fubini/prime-power endpoints or by numerical tables, while explicitly not claiming a paper-sized or formal certification contribution.
